definitions.explanation: A chemical agent used to kill bacteria and other microorganisms, used in medical, agricultural, and household contexts.

examples.japanese: {殺菌剤|さっきんざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}する→消毒する：17818_shoudokusuru⟧。
examples.english: To disinfect hands with a germicide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{殺菌剤|さっきんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: To use a germicide in agriculture.

examples.japanese: ⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{殺菌剤|さっきんざい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{塩素|えんそ}→塩素：12143_enso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{加|くわ}えられている→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: Chlorine is added to pool water as a disinfectant.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{殺菌|さっきん}→殺菌：09781_sakkin⟧ (sterilization, killing bacteria) + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ (agent, preparation). Used in both medical/household contexts (disinfectants) and agricultural contexts (fungicides for crops). The suffix ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ is productive and appears in many chemical/pharmaceutical compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {殺菌剤|さっきんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散布|さんぷ}する→散布する：21621_sanpusuru⟧: to spray disinfectant/fungicide
- {殺菌剤|さっきんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply disinfectant
- ⟦{農薬|のうやく}→農薬：04295_nouyaku⟧{殺菌剤|さっきんざい}: agricultural fungicide

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{消毒剤|しょうどくざい}→消毒剤：22728_shoudokuzai⟧: disinfectant — very similar in household/medical use, but ⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧ implies making something harmless rather than killing organisms
- {除菌剤|じょきんざい}: antibacterial agent — removes bacteria rather than killing them
- ⟦{殺虫剤|さっちゅうざい}→殺虫剤：07036_sacchuuzai⟧: insecticide — kills insects rather than bacteria
